<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown dupes --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown dupes [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--min-size <MIN_SIZE>`
: Ignore files smaller than this (e.g. 100K, 1M, 2G). Default: `1M`.

`--limit <LIMIT>`
: How many groups to list. Default: `20`.

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

`--jobs <JOBS>`
: Readers per device; 1 suits spinning disks, raise it for SSDs. Default: `1`.

`--retry-errors`
: Retry files that failed to read last time.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

Hardlinks count once. Only fully hashed files are grouped, and `dupes` runs `hash` first.

## Examples

```sh
backdown dupes
backdown dupes --min-size 100M --limit 50
backdown dupes --json > dupes.json
```
